title: Neon Serpent
pitch: A neon snake that moves on the beat, and every bite speeds the music up.
coreLoop: Steer toward the next glowing orb while the tempo, and your speed, keeps climbing.
mechanics: the snake steps once per eighth note, so tempo is speed
each orb adds a segment, a point and +6 BPM
every step plays the next note of a synth arpeggio; a kick lands on every beat
loseCondition: Hit a wall or your own tail.

entities.name: serpent
entities.description: cyan-to-violet gradient segments with a glow

entities.name: orb
entities.description: pulsing pink orb that bursts into particles when eaten

artDirection: Near-black grid, neon glow drawn as layered translucent rectangles, beat-synced pulse on the grid.
audio: WebAudio square-wave arpeggio per step, sine kick per beat, rising blip on eat, noise crash on death.
difficulty: Starts at 96 BPM and caps at 276 BPM.
acceptance: Menu shows the title and 'Press SPACE'
Snake moves continuously and turns with arrows/WASD
Eating an orb grows the snake, raises the score and audibly raises the tempo
Hitting a wall or tail shows a game-over screen; SPACE restarts
